title: named_root_binding_refused no longer settles the refused naming intent; an unsettleable read leaves the claim's naming journal pending and blocks naming
outcome: A definitive named_root_binding_refused answer retires that exact naming event, so a stale-fence or no-longer-current claim refusal never leaves the claim's naming journal pending or its checks withheld.
acceptance: named_root_binding_refused is treated as definitive non-application of that exact event: the journal's pending intent is cleared or retired with the refusal recorded after the authority image is learned, keeping the settles_intent/definitively_unbound handling for the retirement kind.

A regression test: a lapsed claim is recovered (fence advances), naming with the stale fence is refused, and a following naming request with the current fence for the same claim_id succeeds and check capture is not Unconfirmed, while the run stays open.
